description: Full-text search of published GMM news articles (title, summary, body), newest first, with an optional desk (section slug) and date range. Partner content is excluded. Matching is the content store's: the words are matched as whole-word prefixes and accents count, so "Male" does NOT find "Malé". For a forgiving search, or one that also covers First Light, entity records, projects, documents and tracker pages, use search_site. Each result carries the canonical URL to cite. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer has a nextCursor (absent on the last page). To continue, call this tool again with the same arguments and cursor set to that value.

cursor.description: Continue a previous result: the nextCursor it returned, unchanged. Only valid with the same other arguments (limit may differ).

name: search_articles

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page: pass it back as the cursor argument, with the same other arguments. Absent on the last page.

total.description: All matching stories, not just this page.

title: Search news articles
